theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U E : Set (Rn N)), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet E volume → HasLocallyFinitePerimeter U E → ∃ Λ : (Rn N → Rn N) → ℝ, (∀ g h : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → tsupport h ⊆ U → Λ (g + h) = Λ g + Λ h) ∧ (∀ (c : ℝ) (g : Rn N → Rn N), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Λ (c • g) = c * Λ g) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → tsupport g ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) → Λ g ≤ C) ∧ ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Λ g = ∫ x in E ∩ U, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g x
